title: A widget visitor stays signed in across a tracy-web restart, and only that visitor
steps: S1: sign in, new process on the same database.
S3: expired, revoked or cleared binding.
evidence: Review 19/10/2026: embedded widget sign-in lived only in process memory; every deploy signed visitors out
fence: Server-side binding keyed by the widget's random cookie

tests: signed in, then a restart: the same visitor is still signed in
another visitor cookie, or none, restores nothing
an expired binding is not restored
signed out elsewhere: not restored, and the binding is forgotten
